jurisdiction.name: Arab League Educational, Cultural and Scientific Organization
jurisdiction.overview: Specialised organisation of the League of Arab States for education, culture and science, based in Tunis; 22 member states.

narrative.summary: ALECSO's AI instrument is the ALECSO Charter on Artificial Intelligence Ethics (June 2025), which sets ethical principles for AI in education, culture and scientific research and was approved at a high-level meeting of member-state representatives on 17 June 2025, according to ALECSO. ALECSO has also published a guide on the ethics of Arab scientific research and AI, and works on AI in education, culture and Arabic language through projects and training.
lead_institutions: ALECSO Information and Communication Technology Department
ALECSO Department of Science and Scientific Research
narrative.review_notes: ALECSO's site was searched for AI charters, strategies and conference decisions; the member list comes from the official data sheets on its Member States page (updated November 2022), and the charter is published in Arabic, the original, with an official English translation. The League of Arab States was not added because its AI texts are known only from news, and a decision recording the charter's adoption and a page on an AI-in-education ethics initiative are still pending.

instruments.scope: ALECSO member states; AI in education, culture, science and research
instruments.summary: Arab regional ethics charter prepared by ALECSO's ICT Department with a committee of experts from 16 Arab states. It sets principles and ethical considerations for AI in education, culture and scientific research, covering issues such as data protection, environmental sustainability and equal access, defines high-risk AI systems (including in health, education and justice), notes gaps in Arab legal frameworks, and calls on all stakeholders, including decision-makers, institutions, researchers and developers, to adopt and apply it. It includes a monitoring and evaluation section.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Arab regional AI ethics charter for education, culture and science, addressed to the 22 ALECSO member states.

instruments.evidence_reference: Research pass 2026-10-21: Corrections only. (1) ALECSO has moved to n.alecso.org; the charter is now listed in the resources repository as view/7 ('ALECSO Charter on Artificial Intelligence Ethics') and view/8 ('ALECSO Code of Ethics for Artificial Intelligence', ICT Department). resource-8-pdf.pdf read: cover 'ميثاق الألكسو لأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي', 'جوان- يونيو 2025', imprint Tunis, ISBN 978-9973-15-463-7 — same as the existing record. Keep old alecso.org URLs if still reachable; the new ones are alternatives. English PDF also at https://n.alecso.org/en/publications/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/etic.pdf. (2) Adoption: ALECSO's own news item (n.alecso.org/en/n/180, dated 2 Jul 2025) states the meeting of 17 June 2025 'unanimously approved and formally adopted' the revised version; participants were official representatives and experts from 16+ Arab states (ministries of education, higher education, communications). No governing-body decision text; lifecycle kept 'published' but the current_status can now cite ALECSO's statement rather than listing it only as a lead. The 15 Aug 2025 news item (n/216) confirms the English release by the Arab Centre for Arabization, Translation, Authorship and Publication (Damascus). | Independent check 2026-10-21: adoption claim (unanimous approval at a virtual meeting of 16+ Arab states on 17 June 2025), English translation date (Aug 2025) and 'not legally binding' are not printed on the resource page or the PDF; resource page titles the English version 'ALECSO Code of Ethics for Artificial Intelligence' (description: 'ALECSO Charter on Ethics for Artificial Intelligence'); PDF text available does not show the scope, monitoring/compliance-indicator or law-amendment provisions claimed in the summary
